correctness.rationale: The cyclically stable 3-subsets of Z/9 form exactly 30 vertices; edges connect disjoint triples, so independence faces are pairwise-intersecting triple families. Independent reconstruction by branching on the least index and imposing disjoint-neighbor masks gives 15,292 augmented faces, 15,291 nonempty simplices, and f-vector (30,297,1311,3054,4212,3639,1974,648,117,9). Independently reconstructed all 7,644 matching pairs from the stated 30-pivot order; the four unmatched masks are (20768,25559040,134217778,268699664), each with four vertices. The entire oriented augmented Hasse graph has 79,812 cover incidences and a topological ordering of all 15,292 masks, proving acyclicity, not sampled gradient paths. Removing the matched empty-face pair leaves a critical 0-cell and exactly four 3-cells, with no cells in dimensions 1 or 2; Forman gives a CW wedge of 4 S^3 integrally. Euler characteristic -3 agrees. Exact 30-vertex claim only.
